FIRSTAMENDMENTTOZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS FIRST AMENDMENT TO ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT, made as of this 12" day of January, 2016 (this “Agreement") is between 625 FULTON ASSOCIA'TES, LLC, a New York Center North, 23"d Floor, Brooklyn, New York 11201 (herein called “Office Owner"), and FC 80 DEKALB ASSOCIATES, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at Forest City Ratner Companies, LLC, One MetroTech Center North, 23"d Floor, Brooklyn, New York, 11201 (herein called"Residential Owner"). RECITALS: 1.Office Owner is the owner of the land described in Exhibit A hereto, which land is designated as Tax Lot I in Block 2094 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Kings County (which land is herein called “Office Owner's Land"), together with the improvements now or hereafter located on Office Owner's Land (herein called “Office Owner's Improvements"; and the Office Owner's Land and the Office Owner's Improvements are herein collectively called “Office Owner's Property"). 2.Residential Owner is the owner of the land described in Exhibit B hereto, which land is designated as Tax Lot 10 in Block 2094 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork,Kings County (which land is herein called “Residential Owner's Land"), together with the improvements now or hereafter located on Residential Owner's Land(herein called“Residential Owner's Improvements"; and the Residential Owner's Land and the Residential Owner's Improveiments are herein collectively called “Residential Owner's Property"). 3.Pursuant to a certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions dated as of Deceinber 3, 2007, by Office Owner and Residential Owner (the “Declaration"), Office Owner's Land and Residential Owner's Land have been merged into a single “zoning lot,” as such term is defined in Section 12- 10 of the Zoning Resolution (such single zoning lot, as the same may be cnlarged or otherwise modified from time to time, being herein called the “Combined Zoning Lot"). The Declaration was recorded in the Office of the Register of the City of New York (Kings County) on December 21, 2007 as CRFN 2007000622479. 4.Office Owner and Residential Owner entered into that certain Zoning Lot Development Agreement dated as of June 24, 2008 (the “ZLDA"), which, among other things, allocated 168,700 square feet of Development Rights from Office Owner's Land to Residential Owner's Land.
